change_summary: Replaced all 8 existing @triton.autotune configs (BLOCK_M=128/256, BLOCK_N=128/256 causing 255 registers/thread due to large accumulator tile) with 16 new configs using BLOCK_M=64/128, BLOCK_N=64/128 where at least one dimension is 64, reducing per-thread accumulator registers from ~128 floats to 32-64 floats to eliminate register spills and improve occupancy from 12.5% to 25-50%.
